Mariah Durham

Preserved Primary Document • durhm-m1.htm

Minnie and Sherry Carney had the following children : Albert Carney (Aug. 1894- ) married Joseph Hamilton Mosley Lizzie Carney (Oct. 1895- ) married Calvin Seeney Helen Carney married William Durham Mary Carney (1905-1946) married Linwood Coombs(1903-1965) both buried at Manship Church in Cheswold, DE Dorothy Carney married Horace Carney, Jr. George Carney married Lucy Carney Goldie Carney married Agnes Carney Wilson Carney (Aug. 1898- ) Minnie died in Kent Co. on 7 November, 1921. She is buried at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold, DE. Her husband, Sherry Carney, died on 6 June, 1933 and is buried next to her.
